words_and_claims_to_avoid: Government look-alike design, 'official notice', fake checks or invoices (39 USC 3001)
Unsubstantiated 'best', '#1', 'guaranteed savings', percent-savings claims (FTC Act s.5)
Invented or composite testimonials, star ratings or review counts (16 CFR 255)
'Free' unless it truly costs nothing and carries no hidden obligation
Fake expiration dates or fake scarcity; any deadline printed must be real
Demographic/age targeting language (e.g., 'seniors', 'retirees') unless the client has evidence it fits their actual buyers
Federal tax-credit claims for heat pumps/AC/furnaces: the 25C Energy Efficient Home Improvement Credit ended for property placed in service after Dec 31, 2025
'Upcoming federal mandates will increase prices up to 24%' (GOLD-hvac-018): unsubstantiated percentage, and EPA's July 2026 rule removed the R-410A install deadline for pre-2025 inventory
'R-410A is banned' / 'you must replace your system': repair and component replacement remain legal
Health claims for IAQ products ('Breathe Pure', 'kills viruses', 'allergy relief') without competent and reliable scientific evidence (GOLD-hvac-052)
'Rebates available' / 'Up to $X in rebates' unless the client names a currently open program (GOLD-hvac-024/044)
compliance_notes: If the sale closes in the home: FTC Cooling-Off Rule (16 CFR 429) applies to $25+ in-home sales; the client's contract must carry the 3-day cancel notice. States can add longer windows (e.g., California's 5-day window for buyers 65+ is documented for solar contracts).

Print the client's contractor license number where the state requires it in ads; requirements vary by state, and the client must confirm their own state's rule (we only verified the specific state rules named below).
Any discount must be off a real, recently charged price.

IRS: 25C not allowed for property placed in service after 12/31/2025 (OBBB, P.L. 119-21). Any 2026+ card must NOT reference a federal tax credit for HVAC. State/utility rebates only if the client verifies the current program.
ENERGY STAR mark only per EPA brand rules; never imply you are EPA.
Repair visits the buyer requested are excluded from Cooling-Off, but upsold equipment during the visit is covered.

Reg Z, 12 CFR 1026.24 (verified): if a card states a down payment amount or %, the number of payments or repayment period (e.g., 'for 18 months', 'no payments for 12 months'), a payment amount ('$99/mo'), or a finance charge amount, it must also state the down payment, the full repayment terms and the 'annual percentage rate' using that term. Any rate (e.g., '0%') must be stated as an APR. Terms must be ones actually offered. Safe alternative: 'Financing available', which uses no trigger terms. Have the lender review.

FTC 'Free' Guide, 16 CFR 251 (verified): (1) 'free with purchase' means the paid item is at its regular price (sold openly for about 30 days), with no markup or downgrade to cover the free item; (2) all conditions go right next to the offer, not in an asterisk footnote; (3) if the main job is priced by negotiation or bid (typical for roofs, siding and window packages), 'free [item] with purchase' is improper; (4) don't run the same 'free' offer more than 6 months in any 12; (5) 'gift' or 'bonus' wording doesn't cure a deceptive 'free'.

Warranty ads, 16 CFR 239 + 702 (verified): 'lifetime/life' must say whose or what life (239.4); 'satisfaction/money-back guarantee' only if the full price is refunded on request, with conditions disclosed (239.3); advertise a warranty only if it is promptly honored (239.5). For consumer products over $15 with a written warranty, the terms must be available before sale; door-to-door sellers must tell buyers before closing that copies are available (702.3); ads should say where the full warranty can be seen (239.2).

EPA Technology Transitions (verified 2026-11-02): final rule published 5/26/2026, effective 7/27/2026, removes the 1/1/2026 installation deadline for residential/light-commercial AC and heat-pump split systems whose specified components were all made or imported before 1/1/2025; that inventory may be installed until depleted. Other new systems must use refrigerant under 700 GWP. Homeowners may repair and replace components of existing R-410A systems. Note: EPA's FAQ page still shows the old 1/1/2026 text; the Federal Register rule wins.

IRA home energy rebates (HEAR/HOMES), checked 2026-11-02: most states not open, paused or waitlisted; DOE revised rules effective 9/1/2026 bar HEAR electric-appliance rebates for oil/gas-to-electric fuel switching (electric-to-electric or new construction only) per NEFI trade-association summary. Do not print 'rebates available' unless the client's state program is open and the job qualifies.
FTC 'Free' Guide applies to 'FREE service call with repair' (GOLD-hvac-040/045): the repair must be at the regular price, conditions next to the offer.

Maintenance memberships with automatic renewal: ROSCA (15 USC 8403) for online sign-ups plus state auto-renewal laws (e.g., California Bus. & Prof. 17602, amended by AB 2863 for contracts on/after 7/1/2025): clear terms, express consent, easy cancellation. FTC 2024 'click-to-cancel' amendments were vacated (8th Cir., July 2025); FTC ANPRM March 2026, no new rule yet.
Gift card tied to financing (GOLD-hvac-057 '$500 gift card with financing'): have the lender review whether it affects Reg Z disclosures; we did not verify a rule on this specific pattern.
'10% off seniors & veterans' (GOLD-hvac-026/045) is a real discount and lawful if honored; it is not evidence that age targeting works (no verified study).
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: fear, joy, pride, relief are all options; the client chooses.
Every angle carries a sell-the-outcome line.
Unverified (agency-only) results are labeled; never quote them as fact on a card.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-hvac-004 'If you have an R-22 model AC, the refrigeration has been banned!' vs EPA
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: EPA wins. Production and import of R-22 ended 1/1/2020, but EPA says there is no ban on using or servicing existing R-22 systems. Accurate framing: 'R-22 is no longer produced; repairs can get pricier. Know your options.'

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-hvac-005 financing headline vs roofing round 5
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Roofing votes don't directly apply to HVAC. Default to financing as secondary and split-test.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-hvac-001/002 '$1,000 rebate' style offers vs 25C credit ending
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Only real, current utility or manufacturer rebates the client verifies. No federal credit.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-hvac-018 'federal mandates will increase prices up to 24%... beat the increase' vs EPA July 2026 rule and FTC substantiation
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law/facts win. The 1/1/2026 install deadline was removed for pre-2025 inventory and the 24% figure is unsubstantiated. Urgency must come from season or a real promo deadline, not a regulatory scare.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-hvac-024/044 'rebates available / up to $1,700 in rebates' vs HEAR/HOMES mostly closed and the 9/1/2026 fuel-switching restriction
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance wins: rebate mentions only when the client names an open program and the job qualifies.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: GOLD-hvac-052 'Breathe Pure, Live Better' IAQ health framing vs FTC health-claim substantiation
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Sell the comfort outcome (fresher-feeling air, less dust) unless the client has competent and reliable scientific evidence for health claims.
